translations.source_sense_description: onder dreiging van geweld iemand geld afnemen

glosses: To take or seize from an unwilling person by physical force, menace, duress, torture, or any undue or illegal exercise of power or ingenuity.

examples.text: to extort contributions from the vanquished
to extort payment of a debt

The Begums' ministers, on the contrary, to extort from them the disclosure of the place which concealed the treasures, were, […] after being fettered and imprisoned, led out on to a scaffold, and this array of terrours proving unavailing, the meek tempered Middleton, as a dernier resort, menaced them with a confinement in the fortress of Chunargar. Thus, my lords, was a British garrison made the climax of cruelties!

glosses: To obtain by means of the offense of extortion.

examples.text: Weirdly, Renton doesn’t look too much older and the same also goes for Sick Boy (Jonny Lee Miller), who has exchanged heroin for cocaine and nowadays runs an escort-and-blackmail business, secretly videoing clients and extorting money, working with his female business partner, Veronika (Anjela Nedyalkova).

examples.text: De minderjarige jongens die homo’s afpersten in de omgeving van Bergen op Zoom, hebben waarschijnlijk tientallen slachtoffers gemaakt.
examples.translation: Les garçons mineurs qui ont extorqué les homosexuels dans la région de Bergen op Zoom, ont probablement fait des dizaines de victimes. — («Tientallen homo's door jonge Marokkanen afgeperst», AD, , 30 juillet 2010)
